mapper.select: SELECT * FROM gemdori_game_tbl WHERE game_genre LIKE CONCAT('%', #{genre}, '%')
SELECT * FROM gemdori_game_tbl WHERE game_price BETWEEN #{min} AND #{max}
SELECT * FROM gemdori_game_tbl WHERE dlc_game = 1 AND game_title = #{baseGameTitle}
SELECT g.*, r.avg_rating FROM gemdori_game_tbl g LEFT JOIN gemdori_rating_tbl r ON g.game_code = r.game_code WHERE g.game_code = #{gameCode}
SELECT * FROM gemdori_game_tbl ORDER BY publishing_date DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM gemdori_game_tbl WHERE game_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR game_genre LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR game_tag LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM gemdori_game_tbl WHERE PUBLISHING_DATE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY PUBLISHING_DATE DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 6
